module: Auxiliary sound controller for a linear movement (cylinder, seat, platform, kickstand...). It measures the length of a "position sensor" beam (found by tag), derives a smoothed velocity from it and plays: a movement loop (volume/pitch depending on velocity, CT parameter = direction), segment sounds at each segmentLength step (up/down) and end-stop sounds (min/max position).
notes: jbeam keys read in init: hasSegments (false), hasEndstops (false), positionSensorBeamTag (required: beam whose length gives the position), segmentLength, minPosition (0), maxPosition (0), positionCalibration (0), velocitySmoothing (5), absVelocitySmoothing (5), absVelocitySmoothingIn / absVelocitySmoothingOut (= absVelocitySmoothing), debugMode (false).

Keys read in initSounds: movementSoundVolume (1), movementSoundEvent (loop, optional), segmentIncSoundEvent / segmentDecSoundEvent (default segmentSoundEvent), minPositionSoundEvent, maxPositionSoundEvent, movementSoundNode_nodes (first element, otherwise 0), movementSoundPitchMinVelocity (0), movementSoundPitchMaxVelocity (2), movementSoundMinPitch (0), movementSoundMaxPitch (1), movementSoundVolumeCoefMinVelocity (0.05), movementSoundVolumeCoefMaxVelocity (0.1), movementSoundPlayingThresholdVelocity (0.05), movementSoundPlayingThresholdVolume (0.05).
The three values movementSoundVolumeCoefMinVelocity, movementSoundPlayingThresholdVelocity and movementSoundPlayingThresholdVolume must be > 0, otherwise logs E and updateGFX becomes nop.
Velocities and positions are in m and m/s (beam length).
If the sensor beam is not found, init stops with a log E and updateGFX stays nop.
Inconsistency: the call order assumes initSounds after init (positionSensorBeamCid is used by initEndstops in initSounds, and reset reads the beam length without a nil check if init failed).
Debug values (debugMode) print one line per frame.

updateGFX.desc: nop at load, then internal updateGFX after a successful init.

init.desc: Finds the sensor beam by tag, reads the segment/end-stop configuration and creates the velocity smoothers.

initSounds.desc: Creates the movement loop and reads the sound events and settings; validates the thresholds. Called by the engine at sound initialization.

reset.desc: Resets the last length, the segment and the smoothers to their initial state.

resetSounds.desc: Stops the loop and rearms the end-stop sounds according to the current position.
